# Identity rework Phase 3 — retire the anonymous-guest layer

## Context

Phases 1–2 of the "Local Players vs Accounts" identity rework landed via PR #46 (merged to `main`). The new model: **Local Player** (logged out) = local profiles + local worlds, zero server calls; **Account** (logged in) = up to 5 server-side profiles, each owning up to 10 online worlds. Phase 2 was deliberately additive — the anonymous-guest layer (better-auth `anonymous()` plugin, "Play online as guest", guest invite-joins) still works.

Phase 3 finishes the reversal of the old "guests first" design: **online play requires an account**. Remove the anonymous auth layer, drop guest UI paths, rewire invite links to require sign-in + profile pick, clean up guest-owned server data, rewrite the guest e2e as a real-account e2e, and update all docs.

Original approved plan: `/Users/hutusi/.claude/plans/multiplayer-is-already-working-zazzy-alpaca.md` (Phase 3 section).

## Open decisions (settle before implementation)

1. **Existing guest-owned online worlds on the live deployment** — drop with release-note warning (default) vs one-time upgrade prompt.
2. **Save-slice keying** — keep `ticket.sub = account id` (roster/kick at account level) vs re-key per-profile (touches game server + save format).

## Scope (from approved plan §Phase 3, to be refined by exploration)

1. Remove anonymous auth: `anonymous()` plugin + `onLinkAccount` (`lib/auth/server.ts`), `anonymousClient()` + `ensureSignedIn` anonymous path (`lib/auth/client.ts`), `isAnonymous` column (`db/schema.ts`, `db/ddl.ts`), guest branches in `AccountPanel.tsx`.
2. Gate online to accounts server-side (reject anonymous / require account in `createWorld`, `createInvite`, `mintTicket` — verify what already landed in Phase 2).
3. Invites require sign-in: `app/join/[token]/page.tsx` — preview world name (no-auth GET), sign in / register, accept invite, pick profile, join.
4. Data migration: handle existing guest-owned worlds/memberships per decision (1).
5. Tests: remove/replace `lib/auth/auth.test.ts` onLinkAccount test; rewrite `e2e/multiplayer.e2e.ts` guest path → real account (fills missing account-play e2e coverage).
6. Docs: rewrite `docs/online.md` identity section; update `docs/protocol.md`, `docs/save-format.md`, `docs/testing.md`, `docs/manual.md`/`docs/reference.md` as needed; `CHANGELOG.md`.

## Branch & PR

New branch `feat/retire-guest-online` (name TBD) off updated `main`; own PR against `hutusi/monecraft` `main`. Focused conventional commits per slice; no AI attribution. Push/PR only when the user asks.

---

## Confirmed facts (exploration pass 1 — auth layer)

- **Only server gate landed in Phase 2**: `worldsService.ts:86` (`createProfile` rejects `owner.isAnonymous`). `createWorld` (:170), `createInvite` (:282), `mintTicket` (:347) are still guest-reachable — Phase 3 must add the account gate (or it becomes moot once anonymous sign-in is impossible; decide belt-and-braces vs rely on plugin removal).
- **Anonymous plugin**: `lib/auth/server.ts:3,41-68` (`anonymous({ onLinkAccount })` — re-parents worlds/invites/members guest→account). Only plugin in the list.
- **Client**: `lib/auth/client.ts:4,15,22` (anonymousClient), `:31,53-54` (`OnlineUser.isAnonymous`), `:57-65` (`ensureSignedIn` → `signIn.anonymous()`, the only such call site).
- **`ensureSignedIn` callers**: `app/join/[token]/page.tsx:26`, `components/GameShell.tsx:172` (playOnline), `components/menu/AccountPanel.tsx:145` ("Play online as guest" handler), + test mock in `AccountPanel.test.tsx`.
- **`isAnonymous` refs**: `db/schema.ts:31-32`, `db/ddl.ts:16`, migration `0000` (:37), `0001` backfill (`IS NOT TRUE`), `lib/online/http.ts:10,16-17`, `worldsService.ts:83,86`, `app/api/profiles/route.ts:19`, `GameShell.tsx:317` (account-mode flip), `AccountPanel.tsx:99,116-127,155`, tests (`auth.test.ts`, `worldsService.test.ts:167,183-187`, `AccountPanel.test.tsx`, `AccountProfileSelect.test.tsx:40`).
- **Migrations**: manual `bun run db:migrate` (drizzle-kit); PGlite paths use `db/ddl.ts` SCHEMA_DDL instead — every schema change mirrors in `db/schema.ts` + `db/ddl.ts` + new migration `0003`. Guest-owned worlds always have `profile_id = NULL` (0001 backfill skipped guests).
- **Cascade cleanup**: `DELETE FROM "user" WHERE is_anonymous IS TRUE` cascades sessions/accounts/worlds (→ their members+invites)/memberships/invites. Column nullable: real accounts have NULL.
- **`lib/auth/auth.test.ts`**: entire file tests guest→account upgrade (onLinkAccount) — delete/rewrite wholesale.
- **Game server / tickets / protocol: zero changes** — `signTicket({ sub, wid, name, skinId, role, pv })` never carried anonymity.
- **e2e**: `e2e/multiplayer.e2e.ts` AND `e2e/cloudSaves.e2e.ts` both drive "Play online as guest" — both need the account rewrite, not just multiplayer.
- **Docs w/ guest refs**: `docs/online.md` (":25-48 Identity: guests first", :12 diagram, :87 join page, :136 local-dev two-guests note), `docs/tuning.md:499`, `CHANGELOG.md:13,26`, comments in `app/api/auth/[...all]/route.ts:5`, `AccountProfileSelect.tsx:18`, `ProfileSelect.tsx:13`, `GameShell.tsx:35-36,163,260`. (`lib/game/engine/state.ts:39` "Survival guests" is unrelated — leave.)

## Confirmed facts (exploration pass 2 — invite/join UI)

- **`app/join/[token]/page.tsx`** (57 lines, sole file under app/join/): resolve preview (no-auth GET) → `ensureSignedIn()` (:26, silent guest mint) → `acceptInviteToken` → "joined" + `<Link href="/">`. **No shell handoff** — no params/pending-join; success = the membership row exists. "Deliberately unmagical" per header comment.
- **`POST /api/invite/[token]`** requires `sessionUser` (401), calls `acceptInvite(db, user.id, token)` — **memberships are account-level; `world_members` has no profileId** (`worldsService.ts:336`). So "pick which profile joins" only affects the play ticket (name/skin), not the membership.
- **CRITICAL GAP**: `OnlineWorldSelect.tsx:49-51` filters `kind === "mp" && world.profileId === profile.id` — an invite-joined world (owner's profileId) is **invisible in account mode**; today it only surfaces in legacy `WorldSelect`'s "Online Worlds" (shows all mp worlds w/ "Joined" label, WorldSelect.tsx:155,282,270-330). Phase 3 removes that legacy section ⇒ must add joined (non-owned) worlds to the account-mode list.
- **`AccountPanel.tsx`**: logged-out branch = "Play online as guest" (:138-156) + "Sign in" (:157). Guest branch (:117-127) = "Keep my worlds — create account" + "Sign out". Signup label switches on `user?.isAnonymous` (:99). `onAuthChange` fires after every auth mutation (:33-36).
- **`GameShell.tsx`**: `playOnline(profile, world, onlineProfile)` (:163-190) calls `ensureSignedIn()` (:172) then `requestJoinTicket(world.id, onlineProfile?.id)`; reconnect re-mints with same profileId (:177-182). Guest path call site `world-select`:292 (`onlineProfile=null`); account path `online-worlds`:307 via `profileFromOnline` (:40-42). `play-online.onlineProfile: null` marks the guest path; quit routes on it (:259-264).
- **`AccountProfileSelect`** = full MenuScreen w/ CRUD chrome (not a bare picker); fetches own data; `CreateProfileForm` → `onPlay(profile)` directly.
- **e2e reality**: no auth helpers/fixtures exist; everything drives the real UI against pglite/memory webServer (`playwright.config.ts:27-56`). `multiplayer.e2e.ts` = host "Play online as guest" + legacy WorldSelect create; friend context hits `/join/:token` (silent guest mint) then legacy list. Invite minted via `page.evaluate` fetch (clipboard unreachable headless). `cloudSaves.e2e.ts:48-50` also clicks "Play online as guest".
- **Component tests to rewrite**: `AccountPanel.test.tsx` tests 1-2 (guest flows, `signInAnonymousCalls` fake). `OnlineWorldSelect.test.tsx` gains joined-world coverage.
- `onlineClient.ts` helpers already sufficient: `resolveInviteToken`, `acceptInviteToken`, `requestJoinTicket(worldId, profileId?)`, `createInviteLink`.

*(Draft — awaiting exploration pass 3: docs inventory, save-slice keying, guest-data cleanup facts.)*

# Phase 3 Plan: Retire the anonymous-guest layer (accounts-only online)

Branch: `feat/account-only-online` off `main`, one PR. Eight slices, each `bun run format` + `bun run lint` green; e2e specs go red at slice 5 and green again at slice 7 (acceptable mid-branch; only lint gates per commit).

---

## Key design calls (made once, referenced by the slices)

**D1 — GameShell "Play locally" door: a `browsingLocal` boolean, not a new screen variant.**
The root render at `components/GameShell.tsx:317` is already a fall-through (not a `screen.name` branch), so the door is a sibling piece of state, not a screen:

- `const [browsingLocal, setBrowsingLocal] = useState(false)`.
- Root render becomes: `if (onlineUser && !browsingLocal) return <AccountProfileSelect … onPlayLocally={() => setBrowsingLocal(true)} />`, else `<ProfileSelect … onBackToAccount={onlineUser ? () => setBrowsingLocal(false) : undefined} />`.
- **Set** `browsingLocal = true` in two places: the Play-locally callback, and the session-resume path (`GameShell.tsx:196-198`) when a local-world pointer resumes — so a signed-in player who reloads mid-local-game and quits walks back out through the *local* menus (world-select → profile-select → "Back to account"), not an abrupt jump to account home.
- **Clear** it whenever `currentUser()` resolves null in `refreshOnlineUser` (`void currentUser().then((u) => { setOnlineUser(u); if (!u) setBrowsingLocal(false); })`) and via "Back to account". Sign-out from inside ProfileSelect's AccountPanel fires `onAuthChange` → this same path, so the stale flag can't survive a sign-out.
- ProfileSelect showing "Signed in as X / Sign out" while browsing locally is **desired**: it's the honest state ("you're signed in, browsing local worlds") and it gives cloud-save context. The way back is a new optional `onBackToAccount?: () => void` prop on `ProfileSelect`, rendered as a "Back to account" `mc-button` (`data-testid="back-to-account"`) directly under the `<AccountPanel/>` in **both** branches — the list view (`ProfileSelect.tsx:51`) **and the firstRun branch (`:36`)**, otherwise a signed-in account with zero local profiles that clicks Play locally is trapped on the create form.

**D2 — `playOnline` sign-in check: drop the pre-check entirely; sharpen the ticket-failure message.**
`playOnline` is only reachable from `OnlineWorldSelect` (account mode), so the user is signed in in every normal flow; the only failure left is an expired session, and `requestJoinTicket` already returns null on 401 which lands in the existing `connectError` alertdialog. Adding a `currentUser()` pre-check would cost a session roundtrip on *every* join to improve one rare message. So: delete line 172, change the message at `:174` to `"could not get a join ticket — are you still signed in, and is the game server configured?"`. `onlineProfile` becomes required (`OnlineProfile`, no null); `Screen` variant `play-online.onlineProfile: OnlineProfile`; quit routing (`:262-264`) collapses to always `{ name: "online-worlds", profile: screen.onlineProfile }`.

**D3 — WorldSelect cloud gating: a `cloudEnabled: boolean` prop.**
GameShell passes `cloudEnabled={onlineUser !== null}`. Inside WorldSelect: the `listOnlineWorlds` fetch (`:68-71`) runs only when `cloudEnabled`; the per-card gate at `:221` swaps `onlineUsed()` → `cloudEnabled`; server list filtered to `kind === "sp-cloud"` only (the `mpWorlds` split at `:154-157` dies). `onlineUsed` import removed from this file. Named `cloudEnabled` (not `signedIn`) because it gates exactly the cloud-saves UI, and GameShell stays the one place that decides what enables it.

**D4 — Join page: 4-phase state machine, reusing `<AccountPanel/>` as-is.**
`{ phase: "loading" } | { phase: "signin"; worldName: string } | { phase: "joined"; worldName: string } | { phase: "error"; message: string }`. Flow: `markOnlineUsed()` first (an invite click IS an online action, and without it GameShell's offline-first `refreshOnlineUser` gate would never probe the session after "Open the game" — this replaces the marking `ensureSignedIn` used to do) → `resolveInviteToken` (null → error) → `currentUser()` → if user, `acceptInviteToken` (false → "used up" error; already-member is idempotent-true) → joined; if no user, phase `signin`: render the world-name preview ("You're invited to **{worldName}** — sign in to join") + `<AccountPanel onAuthChange={() => setAuthNonce(n => n + 1)} />`, with `authNonce` in the effect deps so a successful sign-in/up re-runs resolve→accept. AccountPanel needs no MenuScreen: its classes (`account-panel`, `menu-form`, `menu-field`, `menu-input`, `mc-button`, `account-error`) are global app CSS; render it inside the existing `.net-modal-box`, and do one visual check in the manual pass. Keep the client component, the `cancelled` cleanup, and the "Open the game" link.

**D5 — `auth.test.ts` replacement: keep a lean better-auth-on-PGlite integration test, don't fold it away.**
It's the only test constructing `createAuth` + `drizzleAdapter` against the real schema — exactly the seam that would break if better-auth minded the dropped column or the plugin removal changed session shape. Replace the guest-upgrade suite with ~2 tests: (1) `signUpEmail` creates a user + session cookie; `getSession` returns id/name/email and the `skinId` additional field; (2) `signInEmail` with a wrong password fails, right password yields a session. Keep the `returnHeaders` cookie technique and `closeTestDb` in `afterAll` (exit-99 leak).

**D6 — Migration 0003 mechanics.**
1. Edit `db/schema.ts` (drop `:31-32`) and `db/ddl.ts` (drop `:16`) — these MUST move together (PGlite mirror).
2. `bunx drizzle-kit generate --name retire-anonymous-guests` → emits `db/migrations/0003_retire-anonymous-guests.sql` (`ALTER TABLE "user" DROP COLUMN "is_anonymous";`), `meta/0003_snapshot.json`, and the `_journal.json` entry (idx 3).
3. Hand-prepend to the SQL, following 0001's hand-edit precedent, with a comment block:
   `DELETE FROM "user" WHERE "is_anonymous" IS TRUE;--> statement-breakpoint` before the DROP. FKs cascade worlds/saveBlobs/memberships/invites.
4. PGlite paths need nothing more (fresh DDL each boot). Release note: deploy the new app **first**, then `bun run db:migrate` (old builds SELECT the column via the drizzle schema and would error post-drop; the new build never references it, and the still-present column is harmlessly ignored before migration).

**D7 — OnlineWorldSelect joined worlds.**
Filter (`:49-51`) becomes `world.kind === "mp" && (world.profileId === profile.id || world.role === "member")`, with a comment: *joined worlds appear under every profile — membership is account-level, and their `profileId` is the host's*. The "Joined" label already renders (`:91`) and owner actions are already gated (`:97`). **Cap fix**: `atCap` (`:54`) must count only `worlds.filter(w => w.profileId === profile.id)` or joined worlds visually eat your create quota (the server counts only owned).

---

## Commit slices

### Slice 1 — `feat(menu): list joined worlds in the account online-worlds screen`
Independently valuable; closes the joined-worlds gap while the legacy list still exists (brief double-visibility is fine).
- `components/menu/OnlineWorldSelect.tsx` — D7 filter + cap fix + comment; header doc `:14-18` ("Lists only this profile's…" → owned-or-joined).
- `components/menu/OnlineWorldSelect.test.tsx` — add: a member-role world (host's `profileId`) is visible with "Joined" and renders no Copy invite/Revoke buttons; cap test still counts owned only (seed `MAX_WORLDS_PER_PROFILE` owned + 1 joined, button disabled state per owned count).

### Slice 2 — `feat(menu): "Play locally" door between account home and the local menus`
- `components/menu/AccountProfileSelect.tsx` — new required prop `onPlayLocally: () => void`; button `data-testid="play-locally"`, label "Play locally", placed in a `menu-bottom-row` with the existing "New Profile" primary (mirrors WorldSelect's bottom row); header doc `:14-19` updated (drop "guests can't have profiles").
- `components/menu/ProfileSelect.tsx` — optional `onBackToAccount` prop + button in both branches (D1); doc comment `:13` sweep.
- `components/GameShell.tsx` — `browsingLocal` state, wiring, resume-path set, refresh-path clear (D1).
- `components/menu/AccountProfileSelect.test.tsx` — Play-locally callback test; `components/menu/ProfileSelect.test.tsx` — back-to-account renders only when prop given + fires.

### Slice 3 — `feat(join): invite landing requires an account — preview, inline sign-in, accept`
- `app/join/[token]/page.tsx` — full rewrite per D4 (drops one of the three `ensureSignedIn` callers; the AccountPanel it embeds still shows the guest button until slice 5 — note this in the commit body as a known mid-branch state).

### Slice 4 — `feat(menu): retire the local-menu Online Worlds section; cloud saves gate on the account`
- `components/menu/WorldSelect.tsx` — remove the Online Worlds section (`:270-330`), `onPlayOnline` prop (`:44-45`), `creatingOnline` mode (`:91-114`), invite state (`:57-59`), `createInviteLink/revokeInviteLinks` imports and `createOnlineWorld`'s mp usage; keep Upload-to-cloud (`:127-151`, `:221-235`) and Cloud Saves (`:255-269`) + `onDownloadCloud`; add `cloudEnabled` per D3.
- `components/GameShell.tsx` — world-select screen (`:284-300`): drop `onPlayOnline`, pass `cloudEnabled={onlineUser !== null}`. (`playOnline` signature unchanged until slice 5 so this compiles standalone.)
- `components/menu/WorldSelect.test.tsx` — drop `onPlayOnline` from every render; rewrite the "splits the server list by kind" test (no `online-world-mp1`; sp-cloud downloadable; upload/Synced assertions kept) using `cloudEnabled` instead of the `minecraft_online_v1` localStorage seed; same for the failed-upload test.

### Slice 5 — `feat(auth)!: remove the anonymous guest layer — accounts required for online play`
The big one; everything here is compile-coupled through `OnlineUser.isAnonymous` and `ensureSignedIn`.
- `lib/auth/client.ts` — drop `anonymousClient` import/plugin; `type Client = ReturnType<typeof createAuthClient>`; `OnlineUser` loses `isAnonymous`; `currentUser` mapping simplified; **delete `ensureSignedIn`** (its two remaining callers go in this slice); rewrite module doc `:6-14` (keep the lazy-construction and offline-first rationale — `onlineUsed`/`markOnlineUsed` **stay**, they're the offline-first gate, unrelated to guests).
- `lib/auth/server.ts` — drop the `anonymous` import (`:3`) and the whole `plugins` block (`:41-68`) incl. `onLinkAccount`; drop the now-unused `eq` import and `schema` if unused; rewrite module doc `:7-16` (accounts-only; factory-for-PGlite rationale stays). `emailAndPassword` + `skinId` additional field stay.
- `lib/online/http.ts` — `SessionUser` loses `isAnonymous` (`:10`); mapping (`:16-17`) simplified.

# Phase 3 Plan: Retire the anonymous-guest layer (accounts-only online)

Branch: `feat/account-only-online` off `main`, one PR. Eight slices, each `bun run format` + `bun run lint` green; e2e specs go red at slice 5 and green again at slice 7 (acceptable mid-branch; only lint gates per commit).

---

## Key design calls (made once, referenced by the slices)

**D1 — GameShell "Play locally" door: a `browsingLocal` boolean, not a new screen variant.**
The root render at `components/GameShell.tsx:317` is already a fall-through (not a `screen.name` branch), so the door is a sibling piece of state, not a screen:

- `const [browsingLocal, setBrowsingLocal] = useState(false)`.
- Root render becomes: `if (onlineUser && !browsingLocal) return <AccountProfileSelect … onPlayLocally={() => setBrowsingLocal(true)} />`, else `<ProfileSelect … onBackToAccount={onlineUser ? () => setBrowsingLocal(false) : undefined} />`.
- **Set** `browsingLocal = true` in two places: the Play-locally callback, and the session-resume path (`GameShell.tsx:196-198`) when a local-world pointer resumes — so a signed-in player who reloads mid-local-game and quits walks back out through the *local* menus (world-select → profile-select → "Back to account"), not an abrupt jump to account home.
- **Clear** it whenever `currentUser()` resolves null in `refreshOnlineUser` (`void currentUser().then((u) => { setOnlineUser(u); if (!u) setBrowsingLocal(false); })`) and via "Back to account". Sign-out from inside ProfileSelect's AccountPanel fires `onAuthChange` → this same path, so the stale flag can't survive a sign-out.
- ProfileSelect showing "Signed in as X / Sign out" while browsing locally is **desired**: it's the honest state ("you're signed in, browsing local worlds") and it gives cloud-save context. The way back is a new optional `onBackToAccount?: () => void` prop on `ProfileSelect`, rendered as a "Back to account" `mc-button` (`data-testid="back-to-account"`) directly under the `<AccountPanel/>` in **both** branches — the list view (`ProfileSelect.tsx:51`) **and the firstRun branch (`:36`)**, otherwise a signed-in account with zero local profiles that clicks Play locally is trapped on the create form.

**D2 — `playOnline` sign-in check: drop the pre-check entirely; sharpen the ticket-failure message.**
`playOnline` is only reachable from `OnlineWorldSelect` (account mode), so the user is signed in in every normal flow; the only failure left is an expired session, and `requestJoinTicket` already returns null on 401 which lands in the existing `connectError` alertdialog. Adding a `currentUser()` pre-check would cost a session roundtrip on *every* join to improve one rare message. So: delete line 172, change the message at `:174` to `"could not get a join ticket — are you still signed in, and is the game server configured?"`. `onlineProfile` becomes required (`OnlineProfile`, no null); `Screen` variant `play-online.onlineProfile: OnlineProfile`; quit routing (`:262-264`) collapses to always `{ name: "online-worlds", profile: screen.onlineProfile }`.

**D3 — WorldSelect cloud gating: a `cloudEnabled: boolean` prop.**
GameShell passes `cloudEnabled={onlineUser !== null}`. Inside WorldSelect: the `listOnlineWorlds` fetch (`:68-71`) runs only when `cloudEnabled`; the per-card gate at `:221` swaps `onlineUsed()` → `cloudEnabled`; server list filtered to `kind === "sp-cloud"` only (the `mpWorlds` split at `:154-157` dies). `onlineUsed` import removed from this file. Named `cloudEnabled` (not `signedIn`) because it gates exactly the cloud-saves UI, and GameShell stays the one place that decides what enables it.

**D4 — Join page: 4-phase state machine, reusing `<AccountPanel/>` as-is.**
`{ phase: "loading" } | { phase: "signin"; worldName: string } | { phase: "joined"; worldName: string } | { phase: "error"; message: string }`. Flow: `markOnlineUsed()` first (an invite click IS an online action, and without it GameShell's offline-first `refreshOnlineUser` gate would never probe the session after "Open the game" — this replaces the marking `ensureSignedIn` used to do) → `resolveInviteToken` (null → error) → `currentUser()` → if user, `acceptInviteToken` (false → "used up" error; already-member is idempotent-true) → joined; if no user, phase `signin`: render the world-name preview ("You're invited to **{worldName}** — sign in to join") + `<AccountPanel onAuthChange={() => setAuthNonce(n => n + 1)} />`, with `authNonce` in the effect deps so a successful sign-in/up re-runs resolve→accept. AccountPanel needs no MenuScreen: its classes (`account-panel`, `menu-form`, `menu-field`, `menu-input`, `mc-button`, `account-error`) are global app CSS; render it inside the existing `.net-modal-box`, and do one visual check in the manual pass. Keep the client component, the `cancelled` cleanup, and the "Open the game" link.

**D5 — `auth.test.ts` replacement: keep a lean better-auth-on-PGlite integration test, don't fold it away.**
It's the only test constructing `createAuth` + `drizzleAdapter` against the real schema — exactly the seam that would break if better-auth minded the dropped column or the plugin removal changed session shape. Replace the guest-upgrade suite with ~2 tests: (1) `signUpEmail` creates a user + session cookie; `getSession` returns id/name/email and the `skinId` additional field; (2) `signInEmail` with a wrong password fails, right password yields a session. Keep the `returnHeaders` cookie technique and `closeTestDb` in `afterAll` (exit-99 leak).

**D6 — Migration 0003 mechanics.**
1. Edit `db/schema.ts` (drop `:31-32`) and `db/ddl.ts` (drop `:16`) — these MUST move together (PGlite mirror).
2. `bunx drizzle-kit generate --name retire-anonymous-guests` → emits `db/migrations/0003_retire-anonymous-guests.sql` (`ALTER TABLE "user" DROP COLUMN "is_anonymous";`), `meta/0003_snapshot.json`, and the `_journal.json` entry (idx 3).
3. Hand-prepend to the SQL, following 0001's hand-edit precedent, with a comment block:
   `DELETE FROM "user" WHERE "is_anonymous" IS TRUE;--> statement-breakpoint` before the DROP. FKs cascade worlds/saveBlobs/memberships/invites.
4. PGlite paths need nothing more (fresh DDL each boot). Release note: deploy the new app **first**, then `bun run db:migrate` (old builds SELECT the column via the drizzle schema and would error post-drop; the new build never references it, and the still-present column is harmlessly ignored before migration).

**D7 — OnlineWorldSelect joined worlds.**
Filter (`:49-51`) becomes `world.kind === "mp" && (world.profileId === profile.id || world.role === "member")`, with a comment: *joined worlds appear under every profile — membership is account-level, and their `profileId` is the host's*. The "Joined" label already renders (`:91`) and owner actions are already gated (`:97`). **Cap fix**: `atCap` (`:54`) must count only `worlds.filter(w => w.profileId === profile.id)` or joined worlds visually eat your create quota (the server counts only owned).

# Identity rework Phase 3 — retire the anonymous-guest layer (accounts-only online)

## Context

Phases 1–2 of the "Local Players vs Accounts" identity rework landed via PR #46 (merged). The model: **Local Player** (logged out) = local profiles/worlds, zero server calls; **Account** (logged in) = up to 5 server profiles (`MAX_ONLINE_PROFILES`), each owning up to 10 online worlds (`MAX_WORLDS_PER_PROFILE`). Phase 2 was deliberately additive — the anonymous-guest layer (better-auth `anonymous()` plugin, "Play online as guest", silent guest-minting on invite links) still works.

Phase 3 completes the reversal of the old "guests first" design (`docs/online.md`): **online play requires an account**. It also fixes two gaps Phase 2 left: signed-in accounts lost access to the cloud-saves UI (it lives in the local `WorldSelect`, which account mode never shows), and invite-joined worlds are invisible in account mode (`OnlineWorldSelect` filters by owner `profileId`; memberships are account-level).

## Decisions (settled with the user, 2026-07-04)

1. **Cloud saves — "Play locally" door.** Account home gains a "Play locally" button into the local menus while staying signed in; cloud-save upload/download stays in `WorldSelect`, gated on a signed-in account.
2. **Guest data — delete via migration 0003.** `DELETE FROM "user" WHERE is_anonymous IS TRUE` (FKs cascade worlds/saveBlobs/memberships/invites), then drop the column. Release-note it.
3. **Save-slice keying — keep account `sub`.** Zero changes to `lib/net/tickets.ts`, `server/`, protocol, save format. Per-profile keying deferred.
4. **Invite flow — unmagical + fix the list.** `/join/[token]`: preview → inline sign-in/register → accept → "Open the game". No profile pick on the page; fix `OnlineWorldSelect` to also list member-role (joined) mp worlds.

## Branch & PR

Branch `feat/account-only-online` off `main`; own PR against `hutusi/monecraft` `main`. Conventional commits, why-focused bodies, no attribution lines. Per-commit local verify = `bun run format` + `bun run lint` only; full gate once before the PR. Push/PR only when the user asks.

---

## Key design calls

**D1 — "Play locally" door = a `browsingLocal` boolean in GameShell**, not a screen variant (the account flip at `GameShell.tsx:317` is the fall-through render, not a `screen.name` branch).
- Set: `AccountProfileSelect.onPlayLocally`, and the session-resume path (`GameShell.tsx:196-198`) when a local-world pointer resumes (so quit walks back out through local menus, not an abrupt jump to account home).
- Clear: "Back to account", and whenever `currentUser()` resolves null in `refreshOnlineUser` (sign-out from ProfileSelect's AccountPanel fires `onAuthChange` → same path, so a stale flag can't survive sign-out).
- `ProfileSelect` gets optional `onBackToAccount?: () => void` → "Back to account" button (`data-testid="back-to-account"`) under `<AccountPanel/>` in **both** branches — list view AND firstRun (else a signed-in account with zero local profiles is trapped on the create form). AccountPanel showing "Signed in as X" while browsing locally is desired (honest state, explains the cloud buttons).

**D2 — `playOnline` drops the `ensureSignedIn()` pre-check** (`GameShell.tsx:172`) with no replacement: it's only reachable from account mode; an expired session makes `requestJoinTicket` return null, landing in the existing `connectError` alertdialog. **D3 — `WorldSelect` gets a `cloudEnabled: boolean` prop** (GameShell passes `onlineUser !== null`): gates the `listOnlineWorlds` fetch (`:68-71`) and the per-card Upload-to-cloud gate (`:221`, replacing `onlineUsed()`); server list filtered to `kind === "sp-cloud"` only.

**D4 — Join page = 4-phase state machine reusing `<AccountPanel/>` as-is**: `loading | signin (worldName) | joined (worldName) | error (message)`. Flow: `markOnlineUsed()` first (**load-bearing** — replaces the marking `ensureSignedIn` did; without it GameShell's offline-first gate never probes the session after "Open the game") → `resolveInviteToken` → `currentUser()` → signed in ? accept → joined : render preview ("You're invited to **{worldName}** — sign in to join") + `<AccountPanel onAuthChange={bump authNonce}/>`; `authNonce` in the effect deps re-runs resolve→accept after sign-in. AccountPanel's classes are global CSS — renders fine inside the existing `.net-modal-box`; one visual check in the manual pass. Keep the accept in the nonce-driven effect, not inside `onAuthChange` (panel unmounts on phase flip).

**D5 — `lib/auth/auth.test.ts` replaced, not deleted**: it's the only test constructing `createAuth` + drizzleAdapter against the real schema (the tripwire if better-auth ever minds the dropped column). ~2 tests: signUpEmail → user + session cookie + `skinId` additional field via getSession; signInEmail wrong/right password. **D7 — `OnlineWorldSelect` joined worlds**: filter (`:49-51`) → `kind === "mp" && (world.profileId === profile.id || world.role === "member")` + comment (joined worlds appear under every profile — membership is account-level; their `profileId` is the host's). "Joined" label (`:91`) and owner-gated actions (`:97`) already exist. **Cap fix**: `atCap` (`:54`) must count only owned (`profileId === profile.id`) worlds — the server caps only owned.

# Identity rework Phase 3 — retire the anonymous-guest layer

## Context

Phases 1–2 of the "Local Players vs Accounts" identity rework landed via PR #46 (merged to `main`). The new model: **Local Player** (logged out) = local profiles + local worlds, zero server calls; **Account** (logged in) = up to 5 server-side profiles, each owning up to 10 online worlds. Phase 2 was deliberately additive — the anonymous-guest layer (better-auth `anonymous()` plugin, "Play online as guest", guest invite-joins) still works.

Phase 3 finishes the reversal of the old "guests first" design: **online play requires an account**. Remove the anonymous auth layer, drop guest UI paths, rewire invite links to require sign-in + profile pick, clean up guest-owned server data, rewrite the guest e2e as a real-account e2e, and update all docs.

Original approved plan: `/Users/hutusi/.claude/plans/multiplayer-is-already-working-zazzy-alpaca.md` (Phase 3 section).

## Decisions (settled with the user, 2026-07-04)

1. **Cloud saves — "Play locally" door.** `AccountProfileSelect` gains a "Play locally" button dropping a signed-in user into the local `ProfileSelect`/`WorldSelect` while staying signed in; cloud-save upload/download stays in `WorldSelect`, gated on a real signed-in account. (Fixes the post-#46 regression where accounts lost cloud-saves access.)
2. **Guest data — delete via migration 0003.** `DELETE FROM "user" WHERE is_anonymous IS TRUE` (cascades worlds/blobs/memberships/invites) then drop the column. Release-note it.
3. **Save-slice keying — keep account `sub`.** Zero ticket/server/protocol/save changes; per-profile keying deferred as its own future project.
4. **Invite flow — unmagical + fix the list.** `/join/[token]`: preview → inline sign-in/register → accept → "Open the game". No profile pick on the page. Separately fix `OnlineWorldSelect` to also list member-role (joined) mp worlds with a "Joined" label — today joined worlds are invisible in account mode.

## Scope (from approved plan §Phase 3, to be refined by exploration)

1. Remove anonymous auth: `anonymous()` plugin + `onLinkAccount` (`lib/auth/server.ts`), `anonymousClient()` + `ensureSignedIn` anonymous path (`lib/auth/client.ts`), `isAnonymous` column (`db/schema.ts`, `db/ddl.ts`), guest branches in `AccountPanel.tsx`.

4. Data migration: handle existing guest-owned worlds/memberships per decision (1).
5. Tests: remove/replace `lib/auth/auth.test.ts` onLinkAccount test; rewrite `e2e/multiplayer.e2e.ts` guest path → real account (fills missing account-play e2e coverage).

# Identity rework Phase 3 — retire the anonymous-guest layer (accounts-only online)

## Context

Phases 1–2 of the "Local Players vs Accounts" identity rework landed via PR #46 (merged). The model: **Local Player** (logged out) = local profiles/worlds, zero server calls; **Account** (logged in) = up to 5 server profiles (`MAX_ONLINE_PROFILES`), each owning up to 10 online worlds (`MAX_WORLDS_PER_PROFILE`). Phase 2 was deliberately additive — the anonymous-guest layer (better-auth `anonymous()` plugin, "Play online as guest", silent guest-minting on invite links) still works.

Phase 3 completes the reversal of the old "guests first" design (`docs/online.md`): **online play requires an account**. It also fixes two gaps Phase 2 left: signed-in accounts lost access to the cloud-saves UI (it lives in the local `WorldSelect`, which account mode never shows), and invite-joined worlds are invisible in account mode (`OnlineWorldSelect` filters by owner `profileId`; memberships are account-level).

Original approved plan: `/Users/hutusi/.claude/plans/multiplayer-is-already-working-zazzy-alpaca.md` (§Phase 3).

## Decisions (settled with the user, 2026-07-04)

1. **Cloud saves — "Play locally" door.** Account home gains a "Play locally" button into the local menus while staying signed in; cloud-save upload/download stays in `WorldSelect`, gated on a signed-in account.
2. **Guest data — delete via migration 0003.** `DELETE FROM "user" WHERE is_anonymous IS TRUE` (FKs cascade worlds/saveBlobs/memberships/invites), then drop the column. Release-note it.
3. **Save-slice keying — keep account `sub`.** Zero changes to `lib/net/tickets.ts`, `server/`, protocol, save format. Per-profile keying deferred.
4. **Invite flow — unmagical + fix the list.** `/join/[token]`: preview → inline sign-in/register → accept → "Open the game". No profile pick on the page; fix `OnlineWorldSelect` to also list member-role (joined) mp worlds.

## Branch & PR

Branch `feat/account-only-online` off `main`; own PR against `hutusi/monecraft` `main`. Conventional commits, why-focused bodies, no attribution lines. Per-commit local verify = `bun run format` + `bun run lint` only; full gate once before the PR. Push/PR only when the user asks.

---

## Key design calls

**D1 — "Play locally" door = a `browsingLocal` boolean in GameShell**, not a screen variant (the account flip at `GameShell.tsx:317` is the fall-through render, not a `screen.name` branch).
- Set: `AccountProfileSelect.onPlayLocally`, and the session-resume path (`GameShell.tsx:196-198`) when a local-world pointer resumes (so quit walks back out through local menus, not an abrupt jump to account home).
- Clear: "Back to account", and whenever `currentUser()` resolves null in `refreshOnlineUser` (sign-out from ProfileSelect's AccountPanel fires `onAuthChange` → same path, so a stale flag can't survive sign-out).
- `ProfileSelect` gets optional `onBackToAccount?: () => void` → "Back to account" button (`data-testid="back-to-account"`) under `<AccountPanel/>` in **both** branches — list view AND firstRun (else a signed-in account with zero local profiles is trapped on the create form). AccountPanel showing "Signed in as X" while browsing locally is desired (honest state, explains the cloud buttons).

**D2 — `playOnline` drops the `ensureSignedIn()` pre-check** (`GameShell.tsx:172`) with no replacement: it's only reachable from account mode; an expired session makes `requestJoinTicket` return null, landing in the existing `connectError` alertdialog.
